reportLabel: OCR-ASSISTED NATIVE LABEL REVIEW — NOT PRODUCTION VERIFIED

policy.ocrRole: OCR is a secondary aid only. Native labels must be visually confirmed before promotion or publication.
policy.cropPolicy: OCR attempts target one menu-label crop per selected research candidate frame, not full videos.
policy.rawOutputPolicy: Raw OCR output is stored separately from catalog candidates.
policy.uncertaintyPolicy: Low-confidence, missing, unavailable, or mismatched OCR never silently corrects existing labels.
policy.sourceMasterHandling: The tool reads manifests and generated research frame derivatives only. It never modifies source-video masters.
policy.catalogMutationPolicy: This workflow does not write native labels back into catalog candidate records.
